title: The Nativity, with God the Father Surrounded by Angels and Cherubim
alt: A kneeling woman and a sitting man are on either side of a nude baby boy as a bearded man, God, and winged angels hover in the sky over a deep landscape. This vertical panel has a rounded top. Against a pale blue sky in the top third, God floats supported and surrounded by youths with short, gold wings and a cloud of winged baby heads painted in cobalt blue. Below, a river winds through grassy hills to the horizon.
